posts.headline: KDP confirms return to Iraqi parliament next week ahead of cabinet vote
posts.summary: KDP says it will return to the Iraqi parliament next week, ending the boycott it launched after a PUK candidate's presidential election during a KDP-absent session, with the move following the PM-designate's Erbil visit and Nechirvan Barzani's Baghdad track.

posts.headline: Lanaz refinery convoy from Erbil seen heading to the Turkish border
posts.summary: Reports a convoy of tankers carrying refined oil and gas products from the Lanaz refinery in Erbil heading toward Turkey, adding a refined-products lane to the post-Hormuz KRG export and re-export routing build-out.

posts.headline: Halwest, KIU and Komal submit a separate 10-seat proposal to the Coordination Framework
posts.summary: Halwest, the Islamic Union and Komal, together holding 10 seats in Iraq's parliament, say they have submitted a separate proposal to the Shia-led Coordination Framework, framing a non-KDP Kurdish negotiation track that potentially strengthens PUK positioning across federal and regional politics.

posts.headline: All non-KDP Kurdish factions opt for collective negotiation with Shia parties
posts.summary: All Kurdish factions outside the KDP have decided to negotiate collectively with Shia parties, with the smaller-party coalition strengthening negotiating leverage and isolating the KDP, with potential implications for Kurdistan Parliament majority formation.

posts.headline: Washington warns Sudani that militia participation will trigger political, economic and security measures
posts.summary: References reporting that Washington informed al-Sudani that militia participation in his government will result in political, economic and security measures, sketching the cost-side of the State Department's pressure on the cabinet line. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: US will not approve integrating PMF into the formal security institutions, per reporting
posts.summary: References reporting that the United States will not approve integrating the Hashd al-Shaabi into the official security institutions, narrowing the Coordination Framework's room to formalize PMF status inside any Zaidi cabinet structure. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: State Department line on factions reads we seek actions, not words
posts.summary: Cites the US State Department position that on the militia file Washington seeks actions, not words, raising the bar Zaidi has to meet to keep the Strategic Framework cooperation track live. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Foreign Policy line that the Iraqi government finances factions undermining its own authority
posts.summary: References Foreign Policy reporting framing the Iraqi government as financing armed factions that undermine its own authority, the same line being passed inside the State Department demand to strip militia salaries and budget support. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Trump push for an Iraqi government free of terrorism and the militia institutionalization push are unlikely to align
posts.summary: Commentary on the gap between the Trump directive for an Iraqi government free of terrorism and the parallel militia-institutionalization push from inside the system, with the writer arguing the existing political stack will not deliver on either. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Shiite leader frames the Washington condition as cutting militia salaries and allowances
posts.summary: Quotes a Shiite leader framing Washington's condition as targeting the cutting of militia salaries and allowances, lining up with the State Department demand passed to Zaidi to end government salary and budget support to Iran-aligned factions. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Iranian source frames Tehran-Washington gap as still vast despite the MOU work
posts.summary: References an Iranian source framing the differences between Tehran and Washington as still being like sky and earth despite the live one-page MOU framework, casting doubt on near-term final-deal closure even as the 30-day window ticks. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Petraeus reportedly arrives in Iraq within 96 hours, Barrack staying away
posts.summary: Reports former CIA Director and CENTCOM commander David Petraeus arriving in Iraq within a 96-hour window, with Tom Barrack not making the trip, putting a high-profile US security-track presence in Baghdad in parallel to the Hegseth-Zaidi call. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Core US conditions package reads weapons monopoly, faction expulsion, militia funding halt and an explicit state-versus-militia line
posts.summary: Lists the core US conditions on the Iraqi cabinet as monopolizing weapons to the state, expelling factions from government, halting militia funding, and declaring militias separate from the state, framing this as the package no current actor inside the system can fully deliver. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Parliament speaker schedules cabinet vote for early-to-mid next week
posts.summary: Notes the parliament speaker has scheduled the al-Zaidi cabinet vote for early-to-mid next week, lining up with the Shafaq readout on the 14-minister first-tranche submission. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Iranian strikes on the UAE read as a short-sighted strategic call
posts.summary: Commentary endorsing the framing that the Iranian strikes on the UAE were a short-sighted strategic move, picking up an article on the resulting shift in Gulf alignment.

posts.headline: F/A-18 gun run on a vessel rudder, citing CENTCOM
posts.summary: Brief observation on a US F/A-18 gun run on a vessel rudder, picking up a CENTCOM post on the kinetic action against Iranian small boats during the convoy operation.

posts.headline: Akram al-Kaabi photo-op with Qaani read as the safest position available given Quds Force survival odds
posts.summary: Quip on a photo-op of Harakat al-Nujaba leader Akram al-Kaabi standing next to IRGC Quds Force commander Esmail Qaani, framing it as the safest position available given Qaani's repeated survival of war-cycle strikes.
